content.short: Rubic is a cross-chain swap and bridge aggregator for moving assets across TON and many other networks.
content.description: Rubic is a cross-chain swap aggregator that routes token exchanges and bridge transfers across supported blockchains. In the TON context, it gives users a way to move assets between TON and external networks while comparing routes, costs, and execution paths. The product is infrastructure for asset movement rather than a TON-only exchange. Rubic supports DeFi workflows that would otherwise require users to jump between explorers, bridges, dashboards, or routers. Rubic is kept in this TON set because its product has a concrete user or builder workflow, not only a loose mention of the network.
